sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: "More Flags Everywhere": an area anchor with no flag of its own (e.g. a neighbourhood/city not in that userscript's region map, like "Midtown Manhattan" or "Gelsenkirchen"), chained immediately before a DIFFERENT, flagged area anchor, no longer wrongly "borrows" that neighbour's flag icon into its own Locality cell. Region correctly keeps both distinct areas, each with its own correct icon.
